answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the grove log reveals the live set and the echo audit records each lapse. Keeping 179 aliases alive therefore means 179 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the prism quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 149 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
